messages:
Asha: Quick check — locking next Wed for Platform Standards sync. Need a host, two reviewers, and a short pre-read list. Proposed agenda: 1) RFC-289 kv-cache eviction (10m) 2) Design review: batching service (20m) 3) Triage: tail-latency incidents & mitigations (15m). Total ~45m. Can folks claim host/reviewer slots? Ping here when you can. :calendar:

Ben: I can host if no one else steps up. I have an 11:30 conflict but can move things around. Happy to take notes too unless someone else prefers. :raised_hands:

Olivia: I’ll review RFC-289. Can do a 1-paragraph pre-read summary and post it here. I can also cover batching if Ben wants to host.

Kai: I was on the rota but I’m OOO that day — can someone cover my reviewer slot? @Ben if you host, @Zoe could be backup reviewer?

Zoe: I can review batching and help with notes. One ask: could we start 15m earlier to help APAC folks? If y’all are OK I’ll take the early start.

Asha: Thanks — plan: Ben hosts, Olivia + Zoe as reviewers. Start moved earlier by 15m (now 09:30 PT -> 10:15 ET). I’ll update the calendar and attach pre-reads. @Platform-Bot please create the event and add RFC link.

Platform-Bot: Event created: "Platform Standards — Wed 09:30 PT (45m)". RSVP requested. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/ps-standards. Calendar invite sent to attendees.

Ben: RSVP done. Quick thought — can we reserve an extra 10m at the end for follow-ups/action item triage? Might spill over otherwise.

Olivia: +1 to follow-ups. I’ll drop the RFC TL;DR here in ~1h and highlight the decision points.

Zoe: :thumbsup: Posting pre-reads in a sec: RFC-289 link, batching design doc, incident timeline gist.

Asha: Perfect — if anyone else wants to join as ad-hoc reviewer ping here. I’ll close the loop EOD with a final agenda and attachments. Thanks all! :wave:
